sources.excerpt: Preserved current/previous schema ownership, generated 31 contracts and twelve immutable task labels; source and SDK drift checks pass. Later platform/client/release composition remains pending.

Preserved typed revision publication, CAS/read barrier, physical writer and journal fault/replay tests; managed graph currency is scope-based and never scan-age based. No live migration or cross-platform qualification.
Preserved shared 31-URI whole-record resolver with signed revision cursors, MCP structured/text parity and explicit malformed/unknown/unavailable results.

Preserved three-way entity deltas, checkpoint publication and durable source-effect reconciliation; explicit Architect API source now binds its own role. External GUI control and shared budget admission remain 31/6 work.
Preserved six independent immutable policy snapshots, saved/role/session precedence, retention/billing separation and cognitive-role-preserving temperature omission without model/effort escalation.

Implemented pure canonical 17-family bounded retrieval with required plan/slice/ADR/source evidence, structured whole fields, neighbor/record/text/metadata caps, scoped currency and assembly receipts. Real adapter delivery and paired final usefulness remain 25/27; index/evaluator is 4.

Implemented exact r3 generated API/tool/image/effort capability evidence, immutable role adoption, Responses/Chat/Messages request fixtures, strict original local validation, refusals/incomplete/tool errors, shared cancellation and actual per-call usage including failed outcomes. VS Code native Responses streaming and optional Claude schema output pass complete extension suite. Native CLI transport remains separate. Browser strict pass projection/image attachment wiring, execution admission/tree stop and actual CU remain 25/6/17/31 rather than falsely qualified.

Implemented 295-entry typed source inventory, bounded legacy/JSON engine.env codec, revision-CAS durable private backup receipts and recovery, template preview/identity/protected values/undo, requested/effective/source redaction and dashboard/Architect persistence adoption. Concurrency/fault/restart/HTTP fixtures pass; transport authentication, compact UI and platform ACL gates remain 11/23/27.
